report:
MRI of left Knee with 
-3-Plane Loc, Sag PD FS, Sag T2 FS, Sag T1, Cor T2 FS, Ax T2 FS

* Focal mildly increased signal intensity in posterior horn of lateral meniscus on F/S PD sequence  (srs: 4, Img:13), but not visible on F/S T2WI, , maybe due to mortion artifact
* Equal-sized medial and lateral facets of the patella, reflecting Wiberg type I patella.
   Mild wearing of articular cartilage of patella and femoral trochlea, R/O grade 2 chondromalacia. No signficant subchondral bone marrow edema or cysts.
* Subcutaneous infiltration over infrapatellar region.
> No significant bone marrow edema or active cortical destruction noted at distal femur and proximal tibia and fibula in this study.
> The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> No significant myositis noted at distal thights to proximal legs.
> No evidence of tear is noted in medial meniscus in this study.
> Lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> No evidence of bone contusion is noted.
> Interstitial increased signal intensity of quadriceps tendon without thickening, maybe due to normal striated appearance of the distal quadriceps tendon on F/S T2WI; differential diagnosis of  tendinosis.
> Mild subchondral hypointensity area in lateral femoral condyle on T1WI, in favor of mild subchondral sclerosis.
> No significant increased joint effusion of left knee joint.

Impression:
1. R/O grade 2 chondromalacia of left patellofemoral joint.
2. Mild subcutaneous edema over infrapatellar region.

Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation.

Findings: There is a minor knee effusion. Mild myxoid degeneration is noted in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus but no evidence of tears. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  There is mild fraying of the weightbearing aspect of the lateral tibial condyle articular cartilage and medial femoral condyle articular cartilage but no significant subchondral bony change. No evidence of cartilage loss. Mild fraying of the patellar and trochlear articular cartilage is also noted.  Normal visualized bones and surrounding soft tissues.  
Conclusion: No evidence of meniscal tear. Minor focal articular cartilage fraying as described.

Trouvailles : 

Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire avec un petit kyste poplité non-rupturé. Il y a aussi une distension de la bourse des tendons de la patte d’oie inférieure à l’interligne articulaire. 

Il y a des changements dégénératifs légers à modérés du compartiment interne avec un amincissement modéré du cartilage. Ceci est plus proéminent à la partie postérieure du condyle fémoral interne avec des changements réactifs sous-chondraux. Il y a un léger amincissement du cartilage au niveau du compartiment latéral et patellofémoral. 

Il y a des changements dégénératifs intrasubstances impliquant le corps et la corne postérieure du ménisque interne. Il y a une déchirure longitudinale d’orientation horizontale s’étendant de la corne postérieure jusqu’au niveau du corps. La déchirure s’étend à la surface articulaire inférieure du ménisque. Il n'y a pas de fragment déplacé ni de kyste paraméniscal. Le ménisque externe est sans particularité. 

Autrement, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et le tendon du poplité, le biceps femoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette iliotibiale sont sans particularité. 

Conclusion :

Changements dégénératifs légers à modérés, plus proéminents au niveau du compartiment interne, tels que ci-haut. 

Changements dégénératifs intrasubstances du ménisque interne avec déchirure horizontale de la corne postérieure.

Petit épanchement intra-articulaire avec kyste poplité. Légère bursite au niveau des tendons de la patte d’oie inférieure à l’interligne articulaire.

promijenjenog intenziteta signala uz vidljive fisure, izražen subhondralni koštani edem i sitne
subhondralne ciste medijalnog kondila femura - hondromalacija IV°. U središnjem i posteriornom
dijelu medijalnog kondila mogući manji osteohondralni defekti (promjera do 5 mm, tip IIa).
Promijenjen intenzitet signala hrskavice medijalnog tibijalnog platoa - hondromalacija I/II°.
Promijenjen intenzitet signala medijalnog meniska uz kompleksnu rupturu u području tijela i
stražnjeg roga te ekstruziju za oko 3 mm i kranijalnu migraciju.
Distenzija medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta uz suspektnu parcijalnu rupturu meniskofemoralnog
ligamenta.
Održana je debljina hrskavica lateralnog dijela FT zgloba. Hrskavice promijenjenog intenziteta
signala - hondromalacija I° stupnja.
Promijenjen intenzitet signala lateralnog meniska u smislu degenerativnih promjena, bez znakova
rupture.
Lateralni kolateralni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Povišen intenzitet signala prednjeg križnog ligamenta, održanog kontinuiteta u smislu
degenerativnih promjena.
Stražnji križni ligament je blaže degenerativo promijenjen, održanog kontinuiteta.
Wiberg III tip patele. Hondromalacija IV° lateralne fasete patele uz formirane sitne subhodralne
ciste/manje zone koštanog edema. Trohlearna hrskavica primjerene morfologije.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.
Blago povišen intenzitet signala na hvatištu iliotibijalnog trakta za tibiju u smislu entezopatskih
promjena.
Uredan prikaz tetive popliteusa i pes anserinus.
Povišen intenzitet signala ligamenta patele na hvatištu za patelu uz formirane osteofite u smislu
entezopatskih promjena.
Tetiva kvadricepsa primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Umjereni izljev u zglobu uz blagu do umjerenu proliferaciju sinovije.
Baker cista aksijalno veličine oko 27x14 mm uz blaži edem okolnih mekih tkiva - moguće stanje
nakon rupture.
Potkožni edem difuzno. Varikoziteti sliva VSM.

In the medial compartment, there is radial tear at the posterior hornroot of the medial meniscus. There is displaced meniscal fragment into the medial gutter. There is diffuse high grade chondrosis (more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along weightbaring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. There is subchondral edema. Multiple subchondral bone cysts (about intact3intact7 cm) are identified. Osteophytes are present.  
 The lateral compartment, the lateral meniscus is not torn. There is diffuse low grade chondrosis (less than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along weightbaring lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau. There is no subchondral edema. Small osteophytes are present.  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is diffuse low grade chondrosis at medial trochlea. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact. There is no tibial translation. 
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. Tendinopathy of the intraarticular portion, popliteus tendon. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Some amount of left knee effusion with synovitis is present.  
 There is severe fatty muscle infiltration of the soleus, medial, lateral head gastrocnemius muscles.  Medial and lateral tibiofemoral compartmental osteoarthritis of the left knee, predominantly at the medial joint by evidence of chondrosis, subchondral edema, cysts and osteophytes.
